# Ayyapa Wood Works

> Custom wooden doors and handcrafted woodwork in Proddatur and Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh, India. Teak wood doors, pooja doors, carved doors and custom woodwork made to order in custom sizes, finishes and carving details.

## About

Ayyapa Wood Works is a woodworking business based in Proddatur, serving Proddatur, Kadapa and the nearby villages and towns around them. Any wood work will be done here. The workshop makes custom wooden doors and woodwork to order — customers choose a design, share their measurements, and the piece is built to their size, wood type, carving detail and finish. Most doors are made in teak wood. The workshop also uses precision CNC carving for detailed patterns and panels.

## Services and products

- Main doors: custom teak main entrance doors for homes and villas, traditional and modern designs.
- Pooja doors: carved wooden doors for pooja rooms, with deity carvings such as Ganesh, Lakshmi and Venkateswara, and sacred symbols.
- Double doors: wide double-door designs with carved panels, frames and brass jaali work.
- Traditional doors: classic Indian door designs with timeless carved details.
- Modern doors: contemporary wooden doors with clean lines and polished finishes.
- Carved doors: doors with deep hand carving, lattice (jaali) panels, floral and medallion designs.
- CNC carving: precision CNC-carved panels and patterns, finished in the workshop.
- Windows: wooden windows, including louvered door-and-window sets with carved frames.
- Pooja mandirs: custom wooden pooja mandir units with temple-style tops, carved pillars and bells.
- Furniture: bespoke wooden furniture — cots, cupboards, TV units, dining tables, chairs, benches, carved wardrobes and bed headboards.
- Staircases: wooden staircases with carved railings and balusters.
- Wooden partitions: carved wooden jaali partition screens for interiors.
- Choukattu: strong wooden frames for doors and windows, made to measurement.
- Wood polishing (thopda): polishing work that gives doors and furniture a rich, lasting finish.
- Custom woodwork: made-to-measure woodwork for specific spaces — any wood work will be done here.

## How to order

1. Browse the door designs and woodwork on the website.
2. Open any design to see photos, wood type and details.
3. Enquire on WhatsApp (+91 95332 35113) or call +91 99893 56819 with the design and your measurements.
4. The piece is made to order in the chosen size, finish and carving details.

## Common questions

- Do you make doors in custom sizes? Yes — doors and woodwork are made to order in custom sizes, finishes and carving details.
- Which wood do you use? Most doors are made in teak wood.
- Which areas do you serve? Proddatur, Kadapa and the nearby villages and towns around them.
- What other wood work do you make? Cots, cupboards, TV units, dining tables, chairs, benches, choukattu (door and window frames) and wood polishing (thopda) — any wood work will be done here.
- Do you carve pooja doors and mandirs? Yes — pooja doors with deity carvings and custom wooden pooja mandirs are a speciality.
